name: Acuity Scheduling
tagline: The visible appointment scheduling loop is buildable, but a credible replacement needs more than the first screen. Acuity Scheduling earns its keep through OAuth, calendar reliability, so expect a weekend or multi-day build and a narrower personal scope.
